---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What problem does this solve? Who feels the pain, and when?

> e.g. "When I design a page across multiple sessions, I lose all my prompts and have to start from scratch."

## The proposal

What should we build? Be as specific as you can.

> e.g. "Persist the last N prompts + applied operations per hostname in `chrome.storage.local`, and replay them on page load if the user opts in."

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they're less good.

## Design principles check

Does this align with SketchIt's philosophy of:

- [ ] Local-first (no external services)
- [ ] API key stays on user's machine
- [ ] Reversible changes
- [ ] Senior-designer quality bar

If any are a "no," explain the trade-off.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, examples from other tools, etc.
